A list of everything you're wearing. Use this to select an object to add/remove as an exception to licence and confiscation rules, then hit the button below
You must press 'Get Equipped Items' first!!

items.label: Licence Discount Max
items.info:
Gaining ranks in the various factions grants you a discount when buying licences based on your progress
Companions - Weapons, College - Magic, Imperials/Stormcloaks - Armor (Both bikini and normal)

items.label: Short Term Duration
items.info: How long in game days a short term licence will last for. Licence duration will only change when purchased - Changing this won't affect existing licences

items.label: Long Term Duration
items.info: How long in game days a long term licence will last for. Licence duration will only change when purchased - Changing this won't affect existing licences

items.label: Enable Magic Licence
items.info: Enable/Disable magic licences

items.label: Cursed Devices
items.info:
If enabled the mod will first attempt to apply cursed devices to your character that drain her magicka
If disabled the mod will skip adding devices and instead apply a 'magic curse'. This is for people that don't want to be collared for not having a magic licence
You can disable this and leave 'Curses come with Tats' enabled and you'll get the tattoo but no devices. The downside is that there is no collar for you to 'cheat' your way out of the curse by unlocking the collar

items.label: Drain Magicka To
items.info:
How low the magicka curse will drain your magicka to
Set to -10 for old school zero magicka points
Set to anything else if you're a snowberry :P

items.label: Curses Come With Tats
items.info: Curses come with a tattoo that visually identifies you as cursed

items.label: Bikini Curse Overlay:
items.info:
Which area of the body to apply the bikini curse overlay to. Allows the use of custom textures. The stock bikini curse texture is applied to the body
Bikini curse texture path: /Textures/SL Survival/bikini_curse_body.dds

items.label: Magic Curse Overlay:
items.info:
Which area of the body to apply the magic curse overlay to. Allows the use of custom textures. The stock magic curse texture is applied to the face
Magic curse texture path: /Textures/SL Survival/magic_silence_collar.dds

items.label: Trade Restrictions
items.info:
Most law abiding traders won't trade items you don't have a licence for
Some merchants don't care about licences
You can try to persuade them to trade forbidden items with you but at a hefty premium (+33% Buying prices, -33% selling prices)

items.label: Bribe Cost
items.info: This is how much it will cost you to bribe the merchant to trade forbidden items with you if you fail the speech check

items.label: Add Merchant:
items.info:
Set up the current Npc under the crosshairs as a trader
You can assign them a Slaverun region which will dictate if clothes trading is allowed when the clothes licence is set to Slaverun
Or you can assign them as an exception which means they don't care about licences and will trade freely always
Merchant statuses are saved to a json file and automatically imported on new games

items.label: Remove Merchant:
items.info: Reset a merchants assigned Slaverun region or exception status back to default

items.label: Reset All Merchants
items.info: Reset all merchant assigned changes you've made. This will also reset the json file of saved merchant back to blank

items.label: Enforcers Minimum
items.info:
The minimum number of licence enforcers to find patrolling around small towns
Actual will be random between min and max and is randomized each time the town is loaded. Note that the town will need to be unloaded before being randomized again and unloading might not happen as often as you would think
Certain towns may not have enough placed enforcers to cover max - Most towns have 4 max

items.label: Enforcers Maximum
items.info:
The maximum number of licence enforcers to find patrolling around small towns
Actual will be random between min and max and is randomized each time the town is loaded. Note that the town will need to be unloaded before being randomized again and unloading might not happen as often as you would think
Certain towns may not have enough placed enforcers to cover max - Most towns have 4 max

items.label: Guard Enforcers Min
items.info:
When entering a town a random number of vanilla guards will be assigned to enforcer duty and can chase, stop, search and confiscate any licence violations just like enforcers.
Actual number of guard enforcers is random between min and max. Set both to zero to disable guard enforcers

items.label: Guard Enforcers Max
items.info:
When entering a town a random number of vanilla guards will be assigned to enforcer duty and can chase, stop, search and confiscate any licence violations just like enforcers.
Actual number of guard enforcers is random between min and max. Set both to zero to disable guard enforcers

items.label: Responsive Enforcers
items.info: Makes licence enforcers much more responsive to your presence. Probably too responsive for most people

items.label: Persistent Enforcers
items.info:
Persistent Enforcers will continue following you for this long after losing line of sight to give them some semblence of intelligence
They may follow you inside if this is set above zero. Best lose any pursuers before entering a house
Set to zero to revert to the original dumber enforcers

items.label: Enforcer Chase Distance
items.info:
Once a chase has started this is the minimum distance you must be from an Npc before they begin to lose track of you
Persistent Enforcers must be set to 1 or more for this to work
Increasing this makes it more difficult to escape enforcers/guard enforcers.

items.label: Town Enforcer Respawn Time
items.info:
How long before licence enforcers in towns respawn
Can not depend on Skyrim's built-in respawn flag as it relies on the cell being reset which is unlikely to happen in towns very often so this is done with a single update via script
Set to zero to disable respawning via script

items.label: Enable Bikini Licence
items.info:
Enable bikini armor licences
An normal armor licence will cover bikini armors as well so there is no need to buy both

items.label: Enable Bikini Curse
items.info: Enable/Disable the bikini curse. Only really intended to be disabled in emergencies if for some reason the curse is preventing progression

items.label: Out Of Breath Anim Chance
items.info: The chance of playing an out of breath animation when the bikini curse is active

items.label: Heels Are Required
items.info:
The bikini curse will require you to wear heels. Applies to both armor and clothing
Heels are defined as anything that has the HDT heels magic effect or NiOverride heels offset

items.label: Heel Height Required
items.info:
The minimum height your heels must be to satisfy the bikini curse
This only applies to NiO heels. Not HDT heels (a lot harder to get)
Obviously the units here are not 'in inches', so don't think that way

items.label: Test Bikini Armor
items.info:
Test your currently equipped armor and heels as bikini armor
This will display what armor you're wearing and if they have the bikini keyword. This is a very simple test so if the keyword is missing then it's a problem with your setup. Use this if the bikini curse is triggering or your bikini armor is being confiscated even though you have a licence
I recommend using the bikini keyword rather than SLAX flags because Bikini Experience buffs rely on a hard-coded keyword

items.label: Licence Required
items.info:
Determine when clothes licences are required\Never - Never require a licence to have clothes
Always - Always require a licence to have clothes in every town
Slaverun - Clothes licences only required in towns that are currently Slaverun enslaved
Note that a clothes licence only allows you to carry clothes into slaverun towns. You still need to be naked

items.label: Enable Curfew Licence
items.info:
Women are not permitted to wander the streets after hours and should be indoors. When curfew comes into effect you'll be approached by a guard and told to clear the streets. In unwalled towns you'll be taken straight to the inn
Women caught breaking curfew will be punished. Continued infractions will mean you'll likely end up in the kennel (if the town has one nearby)
Buy a curfew licence to be allowed outside at night. Or you can buy the cheaper whore licence instead.

items.label: Time To Clear Streets
items.info:
The amount of time you're given between receiving your first warning to clear the streets and subsequent approaches
This only applies to walled cities! In unwalled towns you'll be sent straight to the inn on first approach

items.label: Begin Time
items.info: The time that gate curfew begins and you will not be allowed to leave until curfew ends

items.label: End Time
items.info: The time that gate curfew ends and you are allowed to leave town again

items.label: Slavetown Begin Time
items.info: The time that gate curfew begins for towns enslaved by Slaverun and you will not be allowed to leave until curfew ends. Can be set the same as normal curfew if you wish

items.label: Slavetown End Time
items.info: The time that gate curfew ends for towns enslaved by Slaverun and you are allowed to leave town again. Can be set the same as normal curfew if you wish

items.label: Enable Property Licence
items.info:
Enable/Disable the property licence. A property licence is required to buy vanilla homes (not hearthfires)
Letting your licence expire or losing it will result in eviction from ALL your vanilla homes

items.label: Licence Required
items.info:
Determine when clothes licences are required\Never - Never require a licence to have clothes
Always - Always require a licence to have clothes in every town
Slaverun - Clothes licences only required in towns that are currently Slaverun enslaved
Note that a clothes licence only allows you to carry clothes into slaverun towns. You still need to be naked

items.label: Enable Stash Tracking
items.info:
Enable/Disable the stash tracking and stealing mechanics
If disabled then all current tracking data will be lost

items.label: Container Type Counts
items.info:
Stash container types matter
If enabled only hunterborns 'hunters cache' provides the best chances of noone finding your stash
If disabled container type does not matter

items.label: Max Road Distance
items.info: How far to the nearest road should be considered safe

items.label: Npcs steal
items.info:
Once NPCs discover your stash they will steal this many items each time they dip into your stash
How often they steal from you is determined by what type of location the container is in
Frequency is highest in cities and lowest in the wilderness

items.label: Add/Remove Exception
items.info:
Add or Remove a container from the stash tracking mechanics
Click this, then open the target container and add an item to the container so the mod knows which container to add/remove
Exceptions are saved and automatically imported on new games

items.label: Remove Temp Exceptions
items.info: Remove all Temporary stash exceptions

items.label: Remove All Exceptions
items.info: Removes all added stash exceptions.

items.label: Enable Drop Stealing
items.info:
Enable/Disable the stealing of items you drop on the ground. Items left on the ground will be 'stolen' if left unattended.
Note items are never deleted in SLS but moved to a container that is normally out of reach. Use the debug menu if you lose something important

items.label: Enable Begging Dialogue
items.info: Disable to globally disable the begging dialogue

items.label: Enable Self Degradation
items.info: Enable/Disable the self degradation mini job you can get from Npcs when begging for something

items.label: Beg Success Gives
items.info:
How many items you're awarded with for successfully begging
Excludes clothes

items.label: Beg Success Gives
items.info:
How many items you're awarded with for successfully begging
Excludes clothes

items.label: Aggression
items.info:
Sex to pay the toll is:
Aggressive/Not Aggressive - Self explanitory
Don't care: Aggressive tag won't be filtered either way
DF willpower fixed: High will (7-10) - Aggressive, Med will (4-6) - 50:50, Low will (0-3) - Unaggressive
DF willpower % chance: % Chance of an unaggressive animation = (10 - Willpower)%
Function will fallback to not filtering the Aggressive tag if no animations were found

items.label: Victim
items.info: Player is/is not a victim when using sex to pay the toll - Being a victim counts as rape

items.label: MWA Curse Chance
items.info: The chance for gifted boots/clothes to be cursed if Mortal Weapons and Armors is installed

items.label: Cell Cost
items.info:
How much the cell in the kennel costs per night
Don't forget to lock the door

items.label: Suits
items.info:
Enable/Disable the adding of suits when entering the kennel (hobbleskirts, pet suits, strait jackets etc)
Suits can cause some oddness when animations are filtered and changed during sex

items.label: Rape Chance Per Hour
items.info:
Your chance of being raped per hour when sleeping outside of the cell
You chance of being raped increase by 5% per hour successfully slept and resets to this value on rape

items.label: Chance Of Creature Rape
items.info:
This is the chance to be raped by a creature rather than the kennel keeper
Note that the first time is always the kennel keeper as it's an introduction of sorts

items.label: Extra Devious Devices
items.info: Each time you are 'visited' by the kennel keeper he will add another devious device. These added extras are not removed when you leave the kennel and are considered as part of the price for admission to the kennel

items.label: Follower Won't Follow
items.info:
If enabled, when you enter the kennel your follower will be disgusted and leave
If disabled they will follow you inside the kennel - Note that there is no follower handling (sex) from this mod
Leave enabled if you consider your follower to be of the dominant type

items.label: Aggression
items.info:
Sex to pay the toll is:
Aggressive/Not Aggressive - Self explanitory
Don't care: Aggressive tag won't be filtered either way
DF willpower fixed: High will (7-10) - Aggressive, Med will (4-6) - 50:50, Low will (0-3) - Unaggressive
DF willpower % chance: % Chance of an unaggressive animation = (10 - Willpower)%
Function will fallback to not filtering the Aggressive tag if no animations were found

items.label: Victim
items.info: Player is/is not a victim when using sex to pay the toll - Being a victim counts as rape

items.label: Slave Device Count Min
items.info:
The minimum number of devious devices to equip on kennel slaves. Min 0, Max 10.
Adding a lot of devices devices can cause some lag when entering the kennel on potato based PCs

items.label: Slave Device Count Max
items.info:
The maximum number of devious devices to equip on kennel slaves. Min 0, Max 10.
Adding a lot of devices devices can cause some lag when entering the kennel on potato based PCs

items.label: Sleeping Npcs Perk
items.info: Adds a perk to the player that makes it easier to pickpocket sleeping Npcs (+33%). It's mostly intended as a way for a fledgling thief to hone her skills. Might work best with other mods that add dangers/risks to being out at night

items.label: Pickpocket Fail Bounty
items.info:
How much of a bounty to get when caught picking pockets
Vanilla: 25 gold. Requiem: 250 gold. SLS: 100 gold.

items.label: Pickpocket Fail Handling
items.info:
Enable/Disable pick pocketing failure handling
When caught picking pockets the mod will attempt to stop npcs from going beserk and will trigger some random consequences instead
Doesn't work on Npcs in scenes as scenes take priority. So don't try it on npcs that are talking to other npcs. This includes the 'stupid dog' scene.

items.label: Num Of Devices To Equip
items.info:
The number of devious devices to equip when caught picking pockets. Set to zero to disable
Actors in scenes are excluded from pickpocket failure mechanics

items.label: Steal Items Worth
items.info:
How much in value of items to take from you when caught picking pockets
Set to zero to disable Npcs taking your stuff
Actors in scenes are excluded from pickpocket failure mechanics

items.label: Drugs To Equip
items.info:
The number of drugs to force equip when caught picking pockets
Actors in scenes are excluded from pickpocket failure mechanics

items.label: Extra Pickpocket Loot Perk
items.info:
Adds a perk to the player that adds a chance to find extra loot on Npcs making becoming a criminal a more tempting proposition for a struggling dragonborn
Loot includes gold, gems, jewelry, spell tomes, potions, food, devious keys and enchanted jewelry
Extra loot won't trigger on beggars, Zaz slaves or SBC slaves

items.label: Chance Of Low Gold
items.info: The chance for an Npc to have a low amount extra gold ~ 10 - 100 ish

items.label: Chance Of Moderate Gold
items.info: The chance for an Npc to have a moderate amount extra gold ~ 100 - 350 ish

items.label: Chance Of High Gold
items.info: The chance for an Npc to have a high amount extra gold ~ 400 - 700 ish

items.label: Min Extra Loot
items.info:
The minimum amount of extra loot drops to try to add to an npc
Actual will be random between min and max
If chance of none > 0% then there is a chance that nothing will be dropped per drop

items.label: Max Extra Loot
items.info:
The maximum amount of extra loot drops to try to add to an npc
Actual will be random between min and max
If chance of none > 0% then there is a chance that nothing will be dropped per drop

items.label: Chance For Food
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra food
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Gems
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra gems
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Soulgems
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra soul gems
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Jewelry
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra jewelry
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Enchanted Jewelry
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra enchanted jewelry
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Potions
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra potions
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Devious Keys
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra devious keys (chastity & restraints only atm)
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Spell Tomes
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra spell tomes
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Chance For Cure Disease Potion
items.info:
The chance for an Npc to have extra cure disease potions
Cure disease potions are also included in the 'Potions' option but have much less chance to spawn due to the number of other potions in the list
If chance of none is zero then you'll have to decrease the chance of something else before increasing this

items.label: Style
items.info:
Off - Player dismemberments off
Random - Always choose a random limb to dismember
Hands First - Dismember hands first up to Arm Depth Max. Then start on the legs
You can limit dismemberment to hands only if you dislike crawling by setting hands only here and set Max Limbs to 2

items.label: Progression
items.info:
One At A Time - Dismember one section of a limb at a time. Eg. Hand, then forearm, then upper arm
Max In One - Dismember to Depth Max in a single blow
Random - Dismember randomly up to Depth Max

items.label: Weapons
items.info: What kinds of weapons can dismember. Self explanatory

items.label: Arms Depth Max
items.info: How far up the arm to dismember. If you don't plan on having leg dismemberment you can dismember up to upper arms and still look ok running around on legs. If you do plan on having leg dismemberment I'd recommend no more than forearm as you'll still be able to crawl around without it looking weird

items.label: Legs Depth Max
items.info: How far up the leg to dismember. I don't recommend any more then lower leg as crawling will look weird without stumps (floating)

items.label: Dismember Cooldown
items.info:
Minimum time before you can get dismembered again. Recommend setting this to something that isn't zero
If set to zero you can get absolutely butchered during bleedout events before enemies are pacified

items.label: Dismember Limbs Max
items.info: The maximum number of limbs (Left arm/right arm/left leg/right leg) that can be dismembered at any one time

items.label: Base Dismember Chance
items.info: The base chance of getting dismembered on power attacks

items.label: Chance Reduction
items.info:
The reduction in dismember chance per 10 points of armor you have
Eg If you have base chance set to 100% and Armor bonus set to 5.0 and have 100 armor then you'd have an actual chance of being dismembered of (100% - ((100 armor / 10.0) * 5.0)) = 50%

items.label: Damage Threshold
items.info: The base damage stat a weapon must have before it can dismember. This should stop whips etc from dismembering

items.label: Health Threshold
items.info: The health a creature must have to dismember you on power attacks. Should stop small animals (skeevers etc) from dismembering you

items.label: Priest Heal Cost
items.info:
How much it costs for priests to restore your limbs
You can also swallow troll cum to restore your limbs
Priests: Whiterun - Danica, Riften - Maramal, Windhelm - Lortheim, Solitude - Freir, Markarth - Anwen/Verulus

items.label: Block Magic
items.info:
When a hand is cut off you will not be able to equip spells to it
Disable if using nipple magic

items.label: Troll Cum Heals
items.info: Swallowing troll cum heals all amputations

items.label: Disable Bathing
items.info: If enabled Survival will disable your ability to bathe when you have no hands (Requires Bathing in Skyrim Tweaked)

items.label: Use Say()
items.info:
Use the function Say() to make the player speak hurt/pain sounds. Say() can cause CTDs under certain circumstances. 
If disabled Play() will be used which just plays the sound effect on the player (players lips won't move)
Try disabling this option if you CTD during dismember events

items.label: Stop Combat
items.info: Attempt to pacify enemies when the player is no longer able to defend herself (both hands cut off).

items.label: Bikini Experience
items.info: Gain experience the more you wear bikini armor and don't wear full armor. As you gain 'bikini levels' bikini armors will provide more armor and you'll be faster and have more stamina when wearing them. Conversely, the higher your bikini level the less armor normal, full armors will provide.

items.label: Base Exp Per Level
items.info:
The base amount of experience needed (in game hours if training speed is 1.0) to level up your bikini skill
Level 1 = 1.0 x Base, Level 2 = 1.0 x Base, Level 3 = 1.5 x Base, Level 4 = 2.0 x Base

items.label: Training Speed
items.info: Modifies how quickly you will train your bikini armor skill. Bigger values decrease training time

items.label: Untraining Speed
items.info:
Modifies how quickly you will untrain your bikini armor skill. Bigger values decrease training time
At default settings it'll take twice as long to untrain your bikini skill

items.label: Bikini Reflexes
items.info:
Your heightened bikini armor reflexes allow you to turn normal hits into 'grazes'
As your bikini skill increases you have an increasing chance to avoid a greater portion of the damage from normal attacks (not power attacks) and spells that do fire/frost/shock damage

items.label: City Vendors
items.info:
How many drops will be added to this container/vendor. If 'chance of none' is greater than zero then nothing might drop for 1 drop
Changes to any settings here will not be applied until you build the leveled lists!!!

items.label: Build Bikini Lists
items.info:
Press this button to begin building the bikini leveled lists and distribute bikinis at traders and chests throughout Skyrim
Note that this is not done automatically on new games etc. You need to do it manually
Changes to any settings here will not be applied until you build the leveled lists with this button!

items.label: Clear Bikini Lists
items.info:
Want to remove bikinis from containers and vendors? Hit this button
Won't remove stuff that's already been added

items.label: Devious Devices
items.info: How many devious devices will be equipped for tolls

All In One Key. Access all of the mod actions, interactions and statuses through this one menu

strings.$sls_openmouthkey_info: A shortcut to open your character's mouth. There's also a button to open your mouth in the 'All in one' menu so this is optional
strings.$sls_combatequipenable_info: To successfully equip armors during combat your character will need to complete an animation without being interrupted (hit by weapon or magic). If enemies are closing in you can interrupt yourself just by moving. If interrupted anything you equipped will be unequipped. The more items you want to change the longer it'll take. Does not apply to weapons/shields/spells. Inactive outside of combat
strings.$sls_dropitems_info:
If enabled armors/clothes/weapons will be dropped during aggressive scenes or events
Includes amputation/dismemberment & Steep Fall strip events. 
Note that if the world mesh of an item is bugged it CAN crash the game. SLS prints to the log what it's about to drop so that you can figure out which mesh is the problem.
strings.$sls_orgasmrequired_info:
For SLSO users. If checked you must make your 'client' orgasm to successfully beg
So you'll have to work for it ;)
This also includes tolls!
strings.$sls_barefootmag_info:
The magnitude of the barefoot speed debuff. Set to zero to disable. Default 50
50 might seem high but it's intended for use with Immersive Fashion's heel training with it's 'Speed Debuff Percentage' set to 75. This way speeds are: Barefoot - 50, Untrained heels - 55, High heel novice - 62 etc.
This way you might be tempted to equip Devious boots yourself instead of being barefoot
Recommend turning off 'Boots slowdown effect' in Devious Devices if using IF.
Don't forget that MinAv may override actual speed
strings.$sls_barefootstaggerchance_info: The chance of stepping on something pointy and staggering. Won't happen while walking. Player squeaks may alert enemies to your presence if sneaking
strings.$sls_horsecost_info:
How much it should cost to buy a horse
Vanilla default: 1000, Survival default: 6000
strings.$sls_growthweightgain_info:
Continue blossoming. Gain this much weight every day
Set to zero to disable
strings.$sls_easybedtraps_info:
If enabled there's a chance you'll be sent on a bondage adventure or the DCL hogtie game when sleeping in 'easy' beds as guild members 'haze the new girl'
Both require Cursed loot. Easy beds only include the companions beds and your student bed at the college of Winterhold at the moment
This does not trigger rape while sleeping
strings.$sls_hardcoremode_info: Disable access to certain MCM elements while your character doesn't have enough gold to afford a Slaverun toll or a short term licence - whichever is highest
strings.$sls_debugmode_info:
Enable/Disable debug mode
Adds some spells for general debugging and displays extra information - Disables magicka curse while active to allow you to cast spells
Doesn't do much right now - to be expanded
strings.$sls_steepfallenable_info:
Steep Fall is an attempt to counter the huge advantage the player has against poor AI pathfinding. You can often escape bad situations by jumping over rocks or down cliffs or up/down steep slopes. Steep fall rag dolls the PC if her height changes too quickly potentially resulting in capture, defeat, injury or even death. I highly recommend a 'Get Up Faster' animation to compliment Steep Fall
Many configuration options are available via /SL Survival/SteepFall.json
strings.$sls_goldweight_info: Adds weight to gold. Set to 0 to disable
strings.$sls_followersstealgold_info: Enable/Disable followers stealing a percentage of the gold you give to them to carry
strings.$sls_folgoldstealchance_info:
The chance a follower has of stealing from you when you give them gold to carry
Set to zero to disable
strings.$sls_folgoldsteamamount_info: How much gold a follower will steal when you give them gold to carry
strings.$sls_fasttraveldisable_info:
Enable/Disable fast travel being disabled when you enter a tolled city
Disabling this will immediately enable fast travel
Enabling again will not disable fast travel immediately - You'll need to reenter the city for that
strings.$sls_ftdisableisnormal_info:
Enable if fast travel is normally disabled in your game by other mods
This will prevent Survival turning fast travel back on when you leave a tolled city
strings.$sls_compasshidemethod_info:
The method the mod employs to hide your compass when you don't have one in your inventory
Transparency: Makes the compass invisible. This is the old way the mod worked but the compass will be briefly visible on game load

strings.$sls_wetlicencedestroychance_info:
The chance for a random licence to become ruined when you become 100% wet

strings.$sls_wetlicencemaxtolose_info:
The maximum number of licences you can lose per 'wet session'. The mechanics are:

strings.$sls_cursetats_info: Curses come with a tattoo that visually identifies you as cursed
strings.$sls_bikinicursearea_info:

Magic curse texture path: /Textures/SL Survival/magic_silence_collar.dds
strings.$sls_searchescorts_info:

This will find any mod added followers and add them to the list
Do this in a quiet cell as it is fairly heavy!
strings.$sls_addescorttolist_info: Adds the current Npc under the crosshairs to your escort list. The Npc must be a member of the PotentialFollowerFaction. Won't work for hirelings like Jenassa. An escort will be assigned to you if caught by the enforcers in a town
strings.$sls_removeescortfromlist_info: Adds the current Npc under the crosshairs to your escort list. The Npc must be a member of the PotentialFollowerFaction. Won't work for hirelings like Jenassa. An escort will be assigned to you if caught by the enforcers in a town
strings.$sls_clearallescorts_info: Clear all escorts from the mod and the Json file
strings.$sls_importescortsfromjson_info: Clear the escort list and re-add escorts from the Json file
strings.$sls_licequiplist_info:
A list of everything you're wearing. Use this to select an object to add/remove as an exception to licence and confiscation rules, then hit the button below
You must press 'Get Equipped Items' first!!
strings.$sls_addlicexception_info: Add/Remove the currently selected object as an exception to the licence system. Excepted objects will not require a licence and will never be confiscated
strings.$sls_licfactiondiscount_info:
Gaining ranks in the various factions grants you a discount when buying licences based on your progress
Companions - Weapons, College - Magic, Imperials/Stormcloaks - Armor (Both bikini and normal)
strings.$sls_discountcollege_info: Magic licence discount that increases based on your rank with the College Of Winterhold
strings.$sls_discountcompanions_info: Weapon licence discount that increases based on your Companions rank
strings.$sls_discountcw_info:
Armor licence discount that increases based on your rank with the Imperials/Stormcloaks
Note that I had to 'make up' a couple of ranks so that each unique mission provides an increase. As a result, imperial/stormcloak ranks don't exactly match vanilla Skyrim ranks
strings.$sls_enforcersmin_info:
The minimum number of licence enforcers to find patrolling around small towns
Actual will be random between min and max and is randomized each time the town is loaded. Note that the town will need to be unloaded before being randomized again and unloading might not happen as often as you would think
Certain towns may not have enough placed enforcers to cover max - Most towns have 4 max
strings.$sls_enforcersmax_info:
The maximum number of licence enforcers to find patrolling around small towns
Actual will be random between min and max and is randomized each time the town is loaded. Note that the town will need to be unloaded before being randomized again and unloading might not happen as often as you would think
Certain towns may not have enough placed enforcers to cover max - Most towns have 4 max
strings.$sls_enforcerguardsmin_info:
When entering a town a random number of vanilla guards will be assigned to enforcer duty and can chase, stop, search and confiscate any licence violations just like enforcers.
Actual number of guard enforcers is random between min and max. Set both to zero to disable guard enforcers
strings.$sls_enforcerguardsmax_info:
When entering a town a random number of vanilla guards will be assigned to enforcer duty and can chase, stop, search and confiscate any licence violations just like enforcers.
Actual number of guard enforcers is random between min and max. Set both to zero to disable guard enforcers
strings.$sls_responsiveenforcers_info: Makes licence enforcers much more responsive to your presence. Probably too responsive for most people
strings.$sls_persistentenforcers_info:
Persistent Enforcers will continue following you for this long after losing line of sight to give them some semblence of intelligence
They may follow you inside if this is set above zero. Best lose any pursuers before entering a house
Set to zero to revert to the original dumber enforcers
strings.$sls_enforcerchasedistance_info:
Once a chase has started this is the minimum distance you must be from an Npc before they begin to lose track of you
Persistent Enforcers must be set to 1 or more for this to work
Increasing this makes it more difficult to escape enforcers/guard enforcers.
strings.$sls_enforcerrespawndur_info:
How long before licence enforcers in towns respawn
Can not depend on Skyrim's built-in respawn flag as it relies on the cell being reset which is unlikely to happen in towns very often so this is done with a single update via script
Set to zero to disable respawning via script
strings.$sls_restricttrade_info:
Most law abiding traders won't trade items you don't have a licence for
Some merchants don't care about licences
You can try to persuade them to trade forbidden items with you but at a hefty premium (+33% Buying prices, -33% selling prices)
strings.$sls_traderestrictbribe_info: This is how much it will cost you to bribe the merchant to trade forbidden items with you if you fail the speech check
strings.$sls_traderestrictaddmerchant_info:
Set up the current Npc under the crosshairs as a trader
You can assign them a Slaverun region which will dictate if clothes trading is allowed when the clothes licence is set to Slaverun
Or you can assign them as an exception which means they don't care about licences and will trade freely always
Merchant statuses are saved to a json file and automatically imported on new games
strings.$sls_traderestrictremovemerchant_info: Reset a merchants assigned Slaverun region or exception status back to default
strings.$sls_traderestrictresetallmerchants_info: Reset all merchant assigned changes you've made. This will also reset the json file of saved merchant back to blank
strings.$sls_licshortdur_info: How long in game days a short term licence will last for. Licence duration will only change when purchased - Changing this won't affect existing licences
strings.$sls_liclongdur_info: How long in game days a long term licence will last for. Licence duration will only change when purchased - Changing this won't affect existing licences
strings.$sls_licweapshortcost_info: How much a short term licence of this type will cost
strings.$sls_licweaplongcost_info: How much a long term licence of this type will cost
strings.$sls_licweappercost_info: How much a perpetual term licence of this type will cost
strings.$sls_licbikinienable_info:

strings.$sls_licbikinicurseenable_info: Enable/Disable the bikini curse. Only really intended to be disabled in emergencies if for some reason the curse is preventing progression
strings.$sls_licbikinitrigger_info:
The Last item to trigger the bikini curse
For your information only - not a selectable option
If the item is boots: Is 'heels are required' enabled? Are the heels 'high' enough?
strings.$sls_licbikiniheels_info:
The bikini curse will require you to wear heels. Applies to both armor and clothing

strings.$sls_licbikiniheelheight_info:

strings.$sls_licbikiniarmortest_info:
Test your currently equipped armor and heels as bikini armor

strings.$sls_licbikinibreathchance_info: The chance of playing an out of breath animation when the bikini curse is active
strings.$sls_licmagiccurseddevices_info:
If enabled the mod will first attempt to apply cursed devices to your character that drain her magicka
If disabled the mod will skip adding devices and instead apply a 'magic curse'. This is for people that don't want to be collared for not having a magic licence
You can disable this and leave 'Curses come with Tats' enabled and you'll get the tattoo but no devices. The downside is that there is no collar for you to 'cheat' your way out of the curse by unlocking the collar
strings.$sls_licmagicchaincollars_info: Allow physics chain collars to be selected for magic curse collars
strings.$sls_licclothesenable_info:

Note that a clothes licence only allows you to carry clothes into slaverun towns. You still need to be naked
strings.$sls_propertylicenceenable_info:

Letting your licence expire or losing it will result in eviction from ALL your vanilla homes
strings.$sls_curfewlicenceenable_info:
Women are not permitted to wander the streets after hours and should be indoors. When curfew comes into effect you'll be approached by a guard and told to clear the streets. In unwalled towns you'll be taken straight to the inn
Women caught breaking curfew will be punished. Continued infractions will mean you'll likely end up in the kennel (if the town has one nearby)
Buy a curfew licence to be allowed outside at night. Or you can buy the cheaper whore licence instead.
strings.$sls_curfewrestartdelay_info:
The amount of time you're given between receiving your first warning to clear the streets and subsequent approaches

strings.$sls_curfewbegin_info: The time that town curfew begins and you will not be allowed to wander the streets until curfew ends
strings.$sls_curfewend_info: The time that town curfew ends and you are allowed to be outside again
strings.$sls_curfewslavetownbegin_info: The time that town curfew begins for towns enslaved by Slaverun and you will not be allowed to wander the streets until curfew ends. Can be set the same as normal curfew if you wish
strings.$sls_curfewslavetownend_info: The time that town curfew ends for towns enslaved by Slaverun and you are allowed to be outside again. Can be set the same as normal curfew if you wish
strings.$sls_stashtracken_info:

If disabled then all current tracking data will be lost
strings.$sls_stashaddremoveexception_info:

Exceptions are saved and automatically imported on new games
strings.$sls_droppeditemstealingen_info:
Enable/Disable the stealing of items you drop on the ground. Items left on the ground will be 'stolen' if left unattended.

strings.$sls_conttypecounts_info:

strings.$sls_roaddist_info: How far to the nearest road should be considered safe

Frequency is highest in cities and lowest in the wilderness
strings.$sls_beggingt_info: Disable to globally disable the begging dialogue

strings.$sls_pplootenable_info:

The chance for an Npc to have extra spell tomes

strings.$sls_pplootcurechance_info:

strings.$sls_ppsleepnpcperk_info: Adds a perk to the player that makes it easier to pickpocket sleeping Npcs (+33%). It's mostly intended as a way for a fledgling thief to hone her skills. Might work best with other mods that add dangers/risks to being out at night
strings.$sls_ppfailhandle_info:
Enable/Disable pick pocketing failure handling
When caught picking pockets the mod will attempt to stop npcs from going beserk and will trigger some random consequences instead

strings.$sls_ppcrimegold_info:
How much of a bounty to get when caught picking pockets

strings.$sls_ppfaildevices_info:
The number of devious devices to equip when caught picking pockets. Set to zero to disable

strings.$sls_ppfailstealvalue_info:
How much in value of items to take from you when caught picking pockets

strings.$sls_ppfaildrugcount_info:
The number of drugs to force equip when caught picking pockets

strings.$sls_dismemberments_info:
Off - Player dismemberments off
Random - Always choose a random limb to dismember
Hands First - Dismember hands first up to Arm Depth Max. Then start on the legs

strings.$sls_dismemberprogression_info:
One At A Time - Dismember one section of a limb at a time. Eg. Hand, then forearm, then upper arm

strings.$sls_dismemberweapons_info: What kinds of weapons can dismember. Self explanatory
strings.$sls_dismemberdepthmaxarms_info: How far up the arm to dismember. If you don't plan on having leg dismemberment you can dismember up to upper arms and still look ok running around on legs. If you do plan on having leg dismemberment I'd recommend no more than forearm as you'll still be able to crawl around without it looking weird
strings.$sls_dismemberdepthmaxlegs_info: How far up the leg to dismember. I don't recommend any more then lower leg as crawling will look weird without stumps (floating)
strings.$sls_dismembermaxampedlimbs_info: The maximum number of limbs (Left arm/right arm/left leg/right leg) that can be dismembered at any one time
strings.$sls_dismembercooldown_info:
Minimum time before you can get dismembered again. Recommend setting this to something that isn't zero

strings.$sls_dismemberchance_info: The base chance of getting dismembered on power attacks
strings.$sls_dismemberarmorbonus_info:
The reduction in dismember chance per 10 points of armor you have

strings.$sls_dismemberchanceactual_info:
Your current actual chance of getting dismembered based on your current armor value

strings.$sls_dismemberdamagethres_info: The base damage stat a weapon must have before it can dismember. This should stop whips etc from dismembering
strings.$sls_dismemberhealththres_info: The health a creature must have to dismember you on power attacks. Should stop small animals (skeevers etc) from dismembering you
strings.$sls_amppriesthealcost_info:
How much it costs for priests to restore your limbs
You can also swallow troll cum to restore your limbs
Priests: Whiterun - Danica, Riften - Maramal, Windhelm - Lortheim, Solitude - Freir, Markarth - Anwen/Verulus
strings.$sls_ampblockmagic_info:
When a hand is cut off you will not be able to equip spells to it
Disable if using nipple magic
strings.$sls_dismembertrollcum_info: Swallowing troll cum heals all amputations
strings.$sls_dismemberbathing_info: If enabled Survival will disable your ability to bathe when you have no hands (Requires Bathing in Skyrim Tweaked)
strings.$sls_dismemberplayersay_info:
Use the function Say() to make the player speak hurt/pain sounds. Say() can cause CTDs under certain circumstances. 
If disabled Play() will be used which just plays the sound effect on the player (players lips won't move)
Try disabling this option if you CTD during dismember events
strings.$sls_dismembercombatstop_info: Attempt to pacify enemies when the player is no longer able to defend herself (both hands cut off).
strings.$sls_bikiniexp_info: Gain experience the more you wear bikini armor and don't wear full armor. As you gain 'bikini levels' bikini armors will provide more armor and you'll be faster and have more stamina when wearing them. Conversely, the higher your bikini level the less armor normal, full armors will provide.
strings.$sls_bikiniexpperlevel_info:
The base amount of experience needed (in game hours if training speed is 1.0) to level up your bikini skill
Level 1 = 1.0 x Base, Level 2 = 1.0 x Base, Level 3 = 1.5 x Base, Level 4 = 2.0 x Base
strings.$sls_bikiniexpreflexes_info:
Your heightened bikini armor reflexes allow you to turn normal hits into 'grazes'
As your bikini skill increases you have an increasing chance to avoid a greater portion of the damage from normal attacks (not power attacks) and spells that do fire/frost/shock damage
strings.$sls_bikiniexptrain_info: Modifies how quickly you will train your bikini armor skill. Bigger values decrease training time
strings.$sls_bikiniexpuntrain_info:
Modifies how quickly you will untrain your bikini armor skill. Bigger values decrease training time
At default settings it'll take twice as long to untrain your bikini skill
strings.$sls_bikinibuildlist_info:
Press this button to begin building the bikini leveled lists and distribute bikinis at traders and chests throughout Skyrim
Note that this is not done automatically on new games etc. You need to do it manually
Changes to any settings here will not be applied until you build the leveled lists with this button!
strings.$sls_bikiniclearlist_info:
Want to remove bikinis from containers and vendors? Hit this button
Won't remove stuff that's already been added
strings.$sls_bikinidropsvendorcity_info:
How many drops will be added to this container/vendor. If 'chance of none' is greater than zero then nothing might drop for 1 drop
Changes to any settings here will not be applied until you build the leveled lists!!!
strings.$sls_bikinichancenone_info:
The chance of this item dropping for each count of the number of drops for a particular container/vendor
If chance of none is equal to zero then you'll have to reduce the chance of something dropping before you can increase the chance of another thing dropping

Changes to any settings here will not be applied until you build the leveled lists!!!
strings.$sls_setinnprices_info:
Allow SLS to start setting the room costs at inns. Most people probably already have an inn price mod so this is disabled by default
You can still set the values when disabled. This allows SLS to determine if you can afford the inn at/near your location for curfew purposes
strings.$sls_tolldodgedwhiterun_info:
Whether or not you've skipped out on the toll in this town. If true the guards will be looking for you on your return
There are too many mods that teleport you out of town through no fault of your own. If that's the case then click the town name to toggle your evasion status

strings.$sls_guardpunishdrugs_info:
Guards may force skooma or lactacid on you as a punishment (guard warnings and curfew).
Off: guards pick another punishment - a fine or a bounty is always possible.
strings.$sls_guardpunishdevices_info:
Guards may lock devious devices on you as a punishment (guard warnings and curfew), and gag you for mouthing off.

strings.$sls_guardpunishkennel_info: Guards may send you to the kennel for the night (guard warnings and curfew).
strings.$sls_guardpunishclothes_info: Guards may take your clothes (guard warnings and curfew).
strings.$sls_guardpunishmilk_info: Guards may take you to a milking machine (guard warnings, needs a milk mod).
strings.$sls_guardpunishconfine_info: Guards may confine you to town for a day (guard warnings and curfew).
strings.$sls_guardpunishtattoo_info: Guards may tattoo you (curfew, needs SlaveTats).
strings.$sls_debuffnotify_info: Show a notification when SL Survival puts a debuff on you or one changes: barefoot, orgasm fatigue, heavy bondage, the bikini curse's breathlessness, the magicka curse and a drug's comedown
strings.$sls_orgasmfatigueexpbonus_info:
